name: pstack
description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence. Third-party plugin by Lauren Tan, ported from Cursor.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous engineering workflows: playbooks, principles, and review skills.
interface.longDescription: A set of rigorous engineering-workflow skills: poteto-mode's 23 playbooks (bug fixes, features, refactors, migrations, autonomous runs), review and investigation skills (how, why, interrogate, architect, arena, swarm), and 23 named engineering principles (root causes, type-system discipline, idempotent operations, and more). Ported from Cursor's pstack plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate pstack skill for this task, or poteto-mode if unsure which one fits.
